name: cursor-codex-pane
description: Open Codex automatically in a right-hand editor group, including SSH workspaces.

cursorCodex.autoOpen.description: Open Codex on the right once when a trusted folder or workspace starts. Closing it keeps it closed until the next window reload.

cursorCodex.hideCursorAgents.description: Hide Cursor's separate Agents pane when opening Codex. Chats are retained.

cursorCodex.fullHeight.description: Hide the bottom panel when opening Codex so the editor pane can use the full height. Terminal sessions are retained.
